title: Get started
goal: A first dive: arm it, send it somewhere, hold its depth and bring it up.

steps.text: Press and hold Arm in the Cockpit tab.
steps.hint: Armed, it answers commands. Disarmed, it stays where it is.

steps.text: Press Go to in the Cockpit tab, then click a place on the map.
steps.hint: Go to takes it to the place you clicked and holds it there.

steps.text: Choose POSHOLD in the Mode menu in the Cockpit tab.
steps.hint: Position hold keeps it where it is, at its depth.

steps.text: Press Land in the Cockpit tab to bring it up.
steps.hint: On a submarine, Land comes up to the surface.

passed: Done. It's coming up to the surface.
